params.topic: Serie A 2018/19-2020/21 first-cycle results, official schedule verification, and official historical pre-kickoff standings snapshots for the 570 second-cycle fixtures
questions: Only process Italy Serie A I1 regular-season fixtures in 2018/19, 2019/20 and 2020/21. The local target is the 570 second-cycle fixtures (official Wk/round 20-38) and the first meeting of the same unordered team pair in that season. Return only missing, newly evidenced, or conflicting rows; do not repeat the existing second-cycle odds rows.

For each target second-cycle fixture, identify the corresponding first-cycle fixture by season plus unordered team pair. Return first_cycle_result with first_fixture_date, first_fixture_round, first_fixture_home_team, first_fixture_away_team, first_fixture_home_goals_90m, first_fixture_away_goals_90m, first_fixture_result_90m, and a stable first_fixture_key. Do not use row order, final standings, odds, Qimen fields, or team occurrence counts to identify the meeting.

Verify the official schedule for both the second-cycle target and its first-cycle partner using an explicit league schedule or official round/matchday source. Return official_round/matchday, date, local kickoff and venue when directly evidenced. Preserve the published round for postponed matches. Never derive official_round from date order or CSV row order. If only a complete secondary schedule is available, label it secondary and retain the official-source gap as unresolved.

For the second-cycle kickoff, obtain an official historical pre-kickoff standings snapshot for both teams when available. For each team return rank, points, matches_played, wins, draws, losses, goals_for, goals_against, goal_difference, snapshot_as_of, snapshot_round, source_url, final_url, field_locator, source_sha256, and field_semantics. The snapshot must be before kickoff and tied to a dated official table or matchday position; final season tables, post-match tables, or values reconstructed only from final results are prohibited.

Prioritize official Lega Serie A, FIGC, or club/league archive pages for standings and schedule. If an official historical snapshot is not available, return NULL with status=unavailable or blocked and explain the source limitation. A secondary source may be returned as a separately labelled cross-check, but it must not be promoted to official.

Every row must contain stable_match_key, season, target_cycle, field_name, value or NULL, status (ok/unavailable/blocked/conflict/parse_failed), source_url, final_url, retrieved_at, field_locator, source_sha256 when available, field_semantics, and evidence_notes. Keep unresolved rows in unresolved_queue and do not collapse conflicts.

Return audit totals by season and field: expected, discovered, identity_matched, complete, partial, unavailable, blocked, conflicts, and unresolved. Include exact counts for first_cycle_result, official_schedule_round, official_schedule_identity, and standings_before_kickoff_home/away.

This is football evidence only. Do not return Qimen charts, palaces, Q/F/G/I/M tokens, chase_relation, draw_value, odds, probabilities, Miss labels, Outcome, Review, Gold, or SQLite writes. Do not claim Method Context completeness merely because a source endpoint exists.
